# Explain Daily Signal Construction and a Prediction Workflow

[← JPMorgan](../README.md) · [Every JPMorgan question](../../jpmorgan.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/explain-daily-signal-construction-and-a-prediction-workflow)

---

Describe a quant initiative where you built a day-by-day indicator and leveraged it to generate forecasts. Detail the pipeline, your personal responsibilities, and the ways you verified that the indicator and forecasting routine performed correctly.

### Constraints & Assumptions
The source reports a deep dive into prior strategy work, specifically daily signal construction and prediction. It does not disclose a particular model, dataset, target, formula, or trading rule. Use your own permitted experience, or explain the method at a high level without revealing confidential details. Do not invent a proprietary strategy to fill the gaps.

### Clarifying Questions
Which aspects of the forecast objective and everyday timing can you disclose? At what moment could the features truly be accessed before the forecast was made? What specific slice of the work was yours? In what manner did the indicator become a forecast, and by what means was its quality assessed?

### What a Strong Answer Covers
An unambiguous step-by-step flow from daily raw data to indicator to forecast, along with assumptions on timing and data access, checks performed, individual input, and a plainly stated limit on confidential information.

### Follow-up Questions
By what method would you eliminate the risk of using future information? If a feature showed up after the deadline or got corrected, what effect would that have? What separates a genuinely helpful forecast from one that looks good in backtests but cannot be trusted?

Overview:
Summarize the building of a day-level quant indicator and its use for forecasting while keeping disclosure suitable, covering inputs as they stood at the time, verification of the process, personal ownership, and limits on sensitive material.
